issue_request: FHIR-35849 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request asking that GuidanceResponse.reasonReference no longer be limited to Condition, Observation, DiagnosticReport, and DocumentReference, and that implementations have a way to identify a path within the referenced resource. The accepted resolution was to change GuidanceResponse.reason to CodeableReference to any resource and add comments about subject-specific data and targetElement/targetPath.

Jira links this application to HL7/fhir#2237. Commit c3432543e2 later fixed the extension links to canonical triple-bracket references without changing the semantics.
